name: Brad Pitt method

lead: The Brad Pitt method is forum shorthand with two uses. In dating talk it is a thought experiment: imagine whether the person who declined would also decline if Brad Pitt had asked. In physique talk, 'Brad Pitt fit' refers to the lean, muscular build the actor had in Fight Club.
Neither use has been studied. As a physique target it is described by T Nation posters as attainable for many without drugs through hard training.

paras: People use the term as a mental benchmark or goal reference rather than a protocol. For the physique, it implies resistance training and diet toward a lean, defined look.
No physical risk attaches to the term itself. Reading rejection through the test is a personal interpretation.

chain: Reference to a famous lean physique
angle.text: Forum users use Pitt's Fight Club build as an example of an attainable lean look. The dating version is a thought experiment rather than a way to change appearance.

lead: The Brad Pitt method is a term used on looksmaxxing and bodybuilding forums. In one sense it names a hypothetical test applied to a declined invitation; in another, 'Brad Pitt fit' or 'the Brad Pitt look' refers to the lean muscular build Pitt displayed in Fight Club (1999) [1][2].

Wikipedia records that Pitt became a sex symbol after Thelma & Louise (1991) and was named People's Sexiest Man Alive in 1995 and 2000, and that he trained for six months for Troy (2004) [1]. A poster on T Nation wrote that the Fight Club look is attainable for most people without gear if they work hard, in contrast to a classic bodybuilder physique [2].

paras: Posters on T Nation have used 'Brad Pitt fit' as shorthand for visible abs and lean muscle short of bodybuilder size [2][3]. Others on the same forum have complained about threads that use him as an example [3].
